title: Assessor report, claim CLM-4471
text: Assessor attended 12 March. Burst flexible hose under the kitchen sink caused sudden water damage to flooring. No evidence of gradual seepage. Estimated repair 3,180 EUR.

title: Assessor report, claim CLM-9002
text: Assessor attended 2 April. Long-term seepage behind shower wall, consistent with lack of maintenance over several years. Recommend decline under clause 7.4.
